tool_args.rationale: The acquired long-horizon observations reveal the predicted sign reversal and, together with five short-horizon points, support numerical fitting of the four parameters in the verified dual-exponential law. Fit positive amplitudes and ordered fast/slow timescales from the paid rows; predict at arbitrary H using the fitted mechanism.
